summary: Contestants demonstrate knowledge and understanding of respectful, responsible, and ethical behavior in a digital world. The event consists of an objective test, and at the National Leadership Conference, contestants take the IC3 Global Standard 6 Level 1 certification exam. Passing the certification adds 50 points to the event score.
time_limits: No more than ten (10) minutes orientation
No more than sixty (60) minutes testing time
No more than ten (10) minutes wrap-up
No more than one hundred twenty (120) minutes for certification test
what_to_bring: Published and/or unpublished non-electronic written reference materials
competencies: Understand the need to protect your digital identity and ensure secure communication by applying cybersecurity best practices and evaluating risks across digital platforms
Understand the need for digital content to be both ethical and responsible across social media and other platforms, ensuring compliance with intellectual property laws
Apply legal, ethical, and compliance standards in technology use, including data privacy, responsible AI use, and prevention of cybercrime
Demonstrate global digital awareness by applying professional etiquette, understanding connectivity implications, and adhering to organizational policies
Understand the process of safely buying or selling online
judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
No equipment, supplies, or materials other than those specified for an event will be allowed in the testing area
Previous Business Professionals of America tests (handwritten, photocopied, or keyed) may not be taken into the testing area. Violation of this rule will result in disqualification.
At NLC, contestants will take IC3 Global Standard 6 Level 1 certification as part of the event. Contestants passing this certification will have 50 points added to their event score.
A Certiport profile must be created at www.certiport.com before attending NLC. Contestants must include their BPA Contestant ID in their Certiport profile when they register.
Reference materials are not allowed for certification testing.
eligibility_notes: Any middle level contestant may enter this objective event.
